answer: Every agent must join a 7-member ridge cohort, locking a 70-credit bond in the ocean registry. Auditors check the cohort pulse each epoch: one failed pulse proof burns all seven bonds. Honest cohorts take one newcomer per epoch, so 1,000 fakes need 143 cohorts. Registration starts at 140 credits and rises by 10 per cohort, so the 1,000th fake pays 70 plus 223, versus 90 for the first; 143 cohorts pay 121,550 in fees plus 70,000 bonds. A rented pulse fails because its signature matches two keys, burning it. An honest agent pays 70 plus 20, refunded after a clean epoch.
